description: Calendar arithmetic for Medicare Advantage appeal deadlines. Give notice_date (the date printed on the plan’s denial notice) for the plan reconsideration deadline: 65 days from that date (the rule is 60 days from receipt, presumed 5 days after the date). Or give care_end_date (the date covered skilled nursing, home health or outpatient rehab care ends, on the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage) for the fast appeal: by noon the day before. The notice’s own instructions come first.

care_end_date.description: The date covered care ends, from the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage, YYYY-MM-DD.

notice_date.description: The date printed on the denial notice, YYYY-MM-DD.
